name: The Rush
source:
"Oh, dear sweet thing. Won't you let me steal you away again?"

You are a pariah. Paying penance for a failure that resulted in bloodshed and betrayal. Of course, it isn't just your failure that marks you, but the way you failed. 

How utterly. 

How intimately.

And to the monster you were meant to hunt and kill, no less.

[From [url=https://arezou.itch.io/the-rush]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“噢，亲爱的小东西。你不会再让我把你偷走吗？”

你是一个贱民。为导致流血和背叛的失败付出忏悔。当然，影响你的不仅仅是你的失败，还有你失败的方式。

多么彻底啊。

多么亲密啊。

对于你注定要猎杀的怪物来说，同样如此。

[来自[url=https://arezou.itch.io/the-rush]itch.io[/url]]
